command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$p1='CampusNetwork_02'; `$p0='CampusNetwork-for-perf_02'; `$nodes=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ('http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/'+`$p1+'/nodes')).name; foreach (`$n in `$nodes) { `$cmd=if (`$n -in @('BJHQ_CSR1000V_GW_01')) {'show running-config'} else {'display current-configuration'}; `$enc=[System.Uri]::EscapeDataString(`$cmd); `$u1='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/'+`$p1+'/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+`$enc; `$u0='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/'+`$p0+'/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+`$enc; try { `$a=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u1).output } catch { continue }; try { `$b=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u0).output } catch { continue }; if (`$a -like 'Error:*' -or `$b -like 'Error:*') { continue }; `$aa=`$a -split "`r?`n" | Where-Object { `$_ -notmatch 'Last configuration|Current configuration :|certificate|^[ !]*[0-9A-F]{20,}|^[ !]*quit$' }; `$bb=`$b -split "`r?`n" | Where-Object { `$_ -notmatch 'Last configuration|Current configuration :|certificate|^[ !]*[0-9A-F]{20,}|^[ !]*quit$' }; `$d=Compare-Object -ReferenceObject `$bb -DifferenceObject `$aa; if (`$d) { '=== '+`$n+' ==='; `$d | ForEach-Object { `$_.SideIndicator+' '+`$_.InputObject } } }"
